title: Toy Prices Change After New Rules
story: Some countries changed their toy trading rules, making toys cost more or less. This change is a chance for toy makers to sell their toys in new places.
storyBig: Countries have adjusted their trade strategies, impacting toy import and export costs. This shift presents an opportunity for toy manufacturers to explore untapped markets and optimize their distribution channels.
think: How do trading rules affect how much toys cost?
bull: Toy makers can find new places to sell their toys.
bear: Toy prices might go up in some places.

title: Not Enough Candy Makers!
story: There aren't enough candy makers to make all the candy we want. This means candy shops might run out of candy! It's a good job to have because everyone loves candy.
storyBig: The current shortage of skilled candy makers has led to supply constraints in the candy industry. With high demand and good wages, the candy-making profession is becoming an attractive career option.
think: What happens when there's not enough candy makers?
bull: Being a candy maker is a cool job with good pay!
bear: Candy might run out in stores.
